notes:
v3.3.4 — Partition Download now requires credits

• Transsion API Change: Single-partition downloads (boot, recovery, vbmeta, etc.) now consume 1 credit per download. This is due to increased API cost on our end for serving individual partition requests — full firmware download remains completely free as always.

• Credit system already in place — if you've used TXFRP or TPP before, you're on the same credit pool. Contact admin to top up.

• Credit balance now updates live across all tabs and in the header pill.
